However, I was unable to locate the actual number of reviews the shop has received. The search for 'May 2023 reviews' returned 30 product results (Maya Tunic products in various sizes and colors), but these appear to be product listings rather than review listings. I attempted to access product pages, admin panels, and various site sections but could not find a specific review count. The store appears to be a demo store with limited functionality. I did not find any review statistics or review count information during my search.
